distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) treated Browne's imported-timber record as requiring confirmation. Although the species is widespread in the Oriental/Pacific region, Taiwanese occurrence was not confirmed.

host_note: No host evidence is reported for this doubtful Taiwan record.
